decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building; interlocking concrete roof tiles for the roof, pebble dash for the front and side elevation, and london stock brick for the rear elevation.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north east wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a front porch, 1st floor side extension, rear roof extension and conversion of existing garage to habitable room to existing house
